recipes.description: Like tadka dal but probably offensive to Italians

stages.name: Ingredient gathering
steps: Water (~2.5 cups - 3 if using fresh tomato not tinned)
Tinned tomatoes (1 can) or one large vine tomato (about half a cup)
Garlic - 7- 8 cloves (3-5 if you're not as big a fan of garlic as me!) or paste (2 tbsp)

stages.name: Choppy bit
steps: Rinse both types of lentil until the water runs clear.
I like to fine dice the onions and tomatoes and finely chop the chillies.
Peel and mince garlic (or use paste)

stages.name: Fry-y bit
steps: Pressure cooker to saute mode on high heat, wait till hot, add oil.
When oil is hot add cumin seeds, chillies, mustard seeds, Asafoetida, dried red chilli, curry leaves and garlic.
Saute until garlic starts starts to brown, add onions.
When onions have turned light pink/brown (about 3 mins) add tomatoes, and fry-y spices.
Combine and saute everything for a further couple of minutes.
Add rinsed lentils and a cup of water... Stir well and deglaze if necessary
Add pasta and remaining two cups of water.

stages.name: Pressure cook
steps: Give it a good stir, make sure nothing is stuck to the bottom
Seal the lid, set to pressure cook HIGH for 5 minutes
Natural release for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest

stages.name: Post pressure cook
steps: Stir well — it'll look thick and glossy
Finish with a squeeze of lime juice and fresh coriander

notes: Red lentils dissolve almost completely and thicken the sauce beautifully

recipes.name: Chana Masala Pasta

stages.name: Ingredient gathering
steps: Tinned tomatoes (1 can) or one large vine tomato (about half a cup)
Amchur dried mango powder (1/2 tsp) - use lime juice after pressure cooking instead if you don't have this
Water (2.5 cups - 3 if you use fresh tomato)

stages.name: Choppy bit
steps: Fine dice onions, tomato if not using tins and finely chop chillies.
If using fresh ginger and garlic, mince or grate them now (or just use paste)
Rinse chickpeas and lentils until the water runs clear.

stages.name: Fry-y bit
steps: Pressure cooker to saute mode on high heat, wait till hot, add oil.
When oil is hot add cumin seeds and green chillies.. When cumin seeds change colour/splutter
Add onions, ginger and garlic, stir and saute.
After about 3 mins add tomatoes and spices.
Stir and saute everything for a further couple of minutes.
Add rinsed chickpeas, lentils, dried mango powder and a cup of water... Stir well and deglaze if necessary
Add pasta and remaining 1.5 cups of water

stages.name: Pressure cook
steps: Give it a good stir, make sure nothing is stuck to the bottom
Seal the lid, set to pressure cook HIGH for 5 minutes
Natural release for 5 minutes, then quick release the rest

stages.name: Post pressure cook
steps: Stir well — it'll look thick and glossy

notes: Add spinach or kale after pressure cooking... spinach wilts instantly.. kale stir in and put the lid on for 5 minutes to steam
Red lentils dissolve almost completely and thicken the sauce beautifully

recipes.name: Rajma Masala Pasta

stages.name: Choppy bit
steps: Rinse lentils till water runs clear and kidney beans

stages.name: Fry-y bit
steps: Pressure cooker on high in saute mode, preheat oil.
Add chillies and cumin seeds and let bloom for 30-40 seconds
Add onion and cook for about 2-3 mins
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for another minute or so.
Add tomatoes and spices and cook for another couple of minutes.

stages.name: Pressure cook
steps: Add kidney beans, lentils and one cup of water and stir well.
Add pasta and remaining 1.5 cups of water and stir well again.
Pressure cook on HIGH for 5 min

stages.name: Post pressure cook
steps: 5 mins natural release then quick release the remaining pressure.
Stir well, add lime juice and stir again.
Chop coriander. add some and stir, keep some for garnish when serving.

notes: Add spinach or kale after pressure cooking too if you have it
If you use plain pasta instead of wholewheat or prefer it al dente, you may prefer to only pressure cook for 4 minutes.
